outlook.statement: Demand conditions expected to remain cautious with brands and retailers adopting measured and flexible approach to sourcing and inventory commitments. Persistent macroeconomic uncertainty and restrained consumer spending may limit pace of recovery, keeping apparel volumes volatile across key markets.

India expected to retain position as fastest-growing major economy, progression towards becoming world's fourth-largest economy by 2027 and third-largest by 2031. India-UK FTA and India-EU FTA expected to create significant opportunities for Indian exporters.

Global growth over the next two years is expected to remain broadly stable, albeit slightly slower, with expansion projected at 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027. India continues to be well placed: real GDP growth in FY 2025-26 is estimated at 7.7%, and the RBI projects 6.6% for FY 2026-27 — keeping India the fastest-growing major economy. The domestic apparel retail market is estimated at around Rs 10 lakh crore in FY 2025-26 and projected to reach Rs 14 lakh crore by FY 2029-30, growing at a CAGR of 9%. The Company is well positioned to capture the next phase of growth in India's apparel market with strong supply-chain capability, disciplined retail expansion and digital integration.

The company continues its focus on expanding its digital presence and operational efficiency through technology, thereby substantially improving the company's sales through this channel. All this should result in increased EBIDTA, going forward.
The Company continues to remain focused on executing its strategic roadmap, reducing expenses and building on the foundations that we have laid to spur our future growth.

The Directors of the Group have assessed the Group's liquidity position, including its current year losses and accumulated losses, together with its available financial resources, expected cash flows and business plans. The Board of Directors are confident of the Group's ability to meet its obligation at least for the next twelve months from the balance sheet date as the net current assets increase exceeds its net current liabilities by Rs 1,132.10 lakhs. Accordingly, these Consolidated Financial Statements have been prepared on a going concern basis.
